title: Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj Stone Inscription
brief_description: Stone inscription associated with the reign of Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, engraved with Sanskrit text.
detailed_description: This stone inscription is associated with Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, the second ruler of the Maratha Empire and the eldest son of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The inscription is engraved in Sanskrit and serves as an important historical record documenting administrative, religious, or commemorative events of the period. Such stone inscriptions provide valuable evidence for understanding the political history, governance, language, and cultural traditions of the Maratha era. The carved symbols above the inscription panel further enhance its historical and artistic significance, making it an important archaeological artifact for the study of medieval Goa and the Maratha period.
